output.summary: The group's roughly 17.6 minute ticket time outside Riverside comes from the October 2024 Made Here redesign. The board knowingly accepted it, and the study projected about 18 minutes (E4, E5). Satisfaction, food quality, check size, same-store sales and margin all improved, and the benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens (E3, E6, E8). Riverside is a local staffing failure. Its saute/pasta cook left, the position stayed unfilled, and transfer requests were deferred by group operations (E10, E11, E13). Why the cook left is unresolved, so the GM blame claim is unsupported. Par-cooked conversion and a 12-minute bonus target are harmful. The trial hurt food quality, and ticket-time incentives were gamed in 2023 (E9, E18). The right moves are to restore Riverside's staffing and reset the benchmark.
